test_title: PYST 52: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The windows / violent banged / during the / storm yesterday.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the fourth part of the given sentence, the adverb form 'violently' should be used instead of the adjective 'violent'.
 
• Adverbs modify verbs and are needed to correctly describe the action.
 
• Adjectives modify nouns and should not be used to describe verbs.
 
• Therefore, the adverb form 'violently' should be used instead of 'violent'.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *The windows violently banged during the storm yesterday.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An adjective describes or modifies a noun, e.g., a violent storm.
 
• An adverb describes or modifies a verb, an adjective, or another adverb, e.g., the wind blew violently.
